items.label: Distributions
items.note: Discrete: $0\le p(x)\le1$, $\sum p=1$. Continuous: $f\ge0$, $\int f=1$; $f$ can exceed 1, areas are probabilities.

items.label: Sum & product rule
items.note: Marginalise by summing the joint; the joint factorises as conditional × marginal.

items.label: Independence / i.i.d.
items.note: Independent: joint = product. i.i.d.: identical marginals, independent draws.

items.label: Bayes' theorem
items.note: Posterior = likelihood × prior ÷ evidence. Likelihood ≠ posterior (alarm story).

items.label: Variance of sums
items.note: Covariance term vanishes for independent variables; differences add variances too.

items.label: Affine maps
items.note: Scaling changes mean and spread, shifting only the mean.

items.label: Gaussian
items.note: Closed under linear maps and sums of independent Gaussians.

items.label: Maximum likelihood
items.note: Maximise the log-likelihood under i.i.d. Judge by generalisation on test data.

items.label: Gaussian mixture
items.note: Latent $z$ hidden; marginal is a weighted sum. Train by EM: E = compute $p(z)$, M = update parameters.

items.label: Gradient descent
items.note: Step against the gradient. Suitable γ ⇒ monotone decrease to a local minimum; too large ⇒ may diverge.
